brief: A PLA L-bracket 60 mm wide, made of 2 mm thick plate. The base leg is 50 mm long and lies flat; the upright leg stands on the back end of the base and is 40 mm tall overall. Two 10 mm holes pass through the base, 20 mm apart across its width, centred 25 mm from the front end. Two 5 mm holes pass through the upright, 20 mm apart across its width, centred 25 mm above the bottom. It carries no load, so there is no load case.
